armor.name: Abeyant Leap
armor.description:
Improves Drengr's Lash and spawns additional projectiles. These projectiles track targets more aggressively, travel farther, and suspend stronger. Gain Woven Mail when you suspend a target.
Improved Drengr's Lash. Gain Woven Mail when suspending targets.

armor.name: ACD/0 Feedback Fence
armor.description:
Melee hits grant Armor Charge, and you take less melee damage from combatants while you have Armor Charge. Taking melee damage causes you to emit a burst of damaging Arc energy that jolts targets, consuming your Armor Charge and dealing more damage based on the number of stacks consumed.
Melee hits grant Armor Charge and store explosive Arc energy.

armor.name: Actium War Rig
armor.description:
Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Auto Rifle or Machine Gun's magazine from reserves. Final blows with Auto Rifles or Machine Guns boost their stability, ammo generation, and damage. Provides a moderate benefit to their airborne effectiveness.
Steadily reloads your equipped Auto Rifle's or Machine Gun's mag.

armor.name: An Insurmountable Skullfort
armor.description:
Final blows with Arc melees trigger health regeneration and fully restore a melee charge. Melee hits grant Arc melee energy.
Arc melee kills grant health and melee energy.

armor.name: Antaeus Wards
armor.description:
While sliding with full class ability energy, you gain a frontal shield that reflects incoming damage. After reflecting damage, your class ability energy is depleted based on the amount of damage reflected.
Sliding reflects projectiles.

armor.name: Apotheosis Veil
armor.description:
Immediately regenerate health, melee, grenade, and Rift energy for you and your nearby allies upon activating your Super. After your Super ends, temporarily gain greatly increased melee and grenade regen.
Ability energy for you and allies on Super cast.

armor.name: Arbor Warden
armor.description:
Using your class ability channels defensive Light inward, providing a grenade that creates a barricade on impact. Picking up Orbs of Power enhances your next Barri-nade, spawning more barricades on impact.
Using your class ability grants a Barricade grenade.

armor.name: Armamentarium
armor.description:
Gain an additional grenade charge. Grenade final blows spawn an Orb of Power. Weapon final blows grant grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads your equipped weapon from reserves.
Gain an additional grenade charge.
Your grenade final blows create Orbs of Power.

armor.name: Ashen Wake
armor.description:
Fusion Grenades gain increased throw speed, explode on impact, and stun Unstoppable Champions. Final blows with Fusion Grenades grant grenade energy.
Improved Fusion Grenades.

armor.name: Assassin's Cowl
armor.description:
Powered melee final blows grant invisibility and restore a portion of health and shields. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the duration of the invisibility and the amount of health and shields restored.
Powered melee kills and finishers grant invisibility and healing.

armor.name: Astrocyte Verse
armor.description:
With Blink equipped, use [Air Dodge]  while airborne to perform a Dark Blink.

Using Blink or Dark Blink grants Volatile Rounds. Blink travels farther, causes nearby targets to become volatile, and has a shorter cooldown. While your Nova Warp Super is active, Dark Blink does not cost Super energy. Provides a moderate benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.
Grants airborne movement and improves Blink.

armor.name: Athrys's Embrace
armor.description:
Weighted Knife gains a second bounce. Rapid precision hits with your weapons grant Weighted Knife a significant damage bonus, bonus melee, and the ability to stun unshielded combatants for a short time.

Empowered Weighted Knife is strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
Weighted Knife bounces twice and deals bonus damage.

armor.name: Balance of Power
armor.description:
Your Threaded Specter has increased duration and durability, and damaging it releases additional Threadlings. While near your Threaded Specter, you do not appear on radar.
Improves Threaded Specter.

armor.name: Ballidorse Wrathweavers
armor.description:
Targets frozen by your Winter's Wrath Super take increased Shatter damage. Allies in range of your Winter's Wrath shockwave and Frostpulse gain Frost Armor and deal increased damage with Stasis weapons. Granting these buffs to allies grants you Super energy.
Winter's Wrath gives targets increased Shatter damage and buffs allies.

armor.name: Blastwave Striders
armor.description:
Gain resistance to your explosives. Defeat targets to charge this armor. Once charged, land a Shiver Strike melee attack or deal explosive self-damage to rocket jump backward and release a blast wave with deadly shrapnel projectiles. The wave freezes combatants and slows Guardians. Charged rocket jumps grant Frost Armor.
Blast your boots to spray your targets with shrapnel.

armor.name: Blight Ranger
armor.description:
Guarding with your Arc Staff does not consume extra Super energy. [Super]  : Cancel Arc Staff early, temporarily increasing Arc weapon damage and creating a blinding burst. Reflected attacks increase the damage of the burst, extend your Super, and deal additional damage.
Attacks you redirect with your Arc Staff deal massively increased damage.

armor.name: Boots of the Assembler
armor.description:
Standing in a rift creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies and heal them. Standing in an empowering rift creates Noble Seekers that grant both you and your ally a damage bonus. When a Noble Seeker finds an ally, you gain class ability energy. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of the Hand Cannon Lumina.
Rifts create beneficial seeker projectiles.

armor.name: Briarbinds
armor.description:
Your Void Souls have a longer duration. They also gain escalating damage and durability as they defeat targets. You can retrieve your Void Souls by interacting with them, allowing them to be redeployed.
Improves duration, damage, and durability of Void Souls.

armor.name: Cadmus Ridge Lancecap
armor.description:
While a Stasis Super is equipped, rapid Stasis weapon damage or damage from behind your Rally Barricade will create a Diamond Lance near you. Thrown Diamond Lances create Stasis crystals. Your Diamond Lances deal more damage based on how much Frost Armor you have.
Improves Diamond Lances.

armor.name: Caliban's Hand
armor.description:
Your Proximity Knife scorches targets it damages with its explosions, or ignites targets on final blow.

After throwing a Proximity Knife, you gain increased melee regeneration until the knife explodes. Gain a small amount of melee energy when your Scorch damages a target, and Ignition final blows fully refund melee energy and can overflow into an additional knife charge.
Improves Proximity Knife effectiveness and regeneration speed.

armor.name: Celestial Nighthawk
armor.description:
Precision final blows reduce the cooldown of your Super. Modifies Golden Gun to fire a single, high-damage shot. Targets defeated by that shot give you Super energy and explode.
Golden Gun fires one high-damage shot.

armor.name: Cenotaph Mask
armor.description:
Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Trace Rifle's magazine from reserves. Damaging a vehicle, boss, or Champion with a Trace Rifle marks them as the target. When an ally defeats the marked target, Special ammo is generated for you and Heavy ammo for your allies.
Improves Trace Rifles.

armor.name: Chromatic Fire
armor.description:
Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super that deals damage and applies a matching elemental effect:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Weakens targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.
Elemental final blows temporarily increase the explosion's size. Precision final blows always maximum the explosion's size.
Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super.

armor.name: Citan's Ramparts
armor.description:
You and allies can shoot through your Towering Barricade. Your Towering Barricade takes increased damage from Guardians.
You and your allies can shoot through your Towering Barricade.

armor.name: Claws of Ahamkara
armor.description:
Gain an additional melee charge. Powered melee final blows spawn an Orb of Power.
Gain an additional melee charge.
Your powered melee final blows create Orbs of Power.

armor.name: Contraverse Hold
armor.description:
Resist incoming damage while charging your Void grenade with Chaos Accelerant. Charged Void grenades return grenade energy on a hit and apply Weaken.
Improved charging for Void grenades.

armor.name: Crest of Alpha Lupi
armor.description:
Generates an additional Orb of Power from Supers. Generating a Barricade, or dealing sustained damage or defeating targets from behind one creates a healing pulse. Healing your allies grants Barricade energy.
More Orbs from Supers. Casting Barricade heals.

armor.name: Crown of Tempests
armor.description:
While you have an Arc ability equipped, Arc ability or Jolt final blows increase the recharge rate of your abilities and extend the duration of Stormtrance.

While you have Conduction Tines, Ionic Sentry creates a Storm Grenade when it deploys.
Arc ability or Jolt final blows restore ability energy.

armor.name: Cuirass of the Falling Star
armor.description:
Greatly increases your Thundercrash damage and grants you damage resistance after impact. Melee final blows while amplified grant you Super energy.
Increases Thundercrash damage.

armor.name: Cyrtarachne's Facade
armor.description:
Activating Grapple grants Woven Mail. While active, Woven Mail provides flinch resistance and health when defeating targets.
Gain Woven Mail when activating Grapple. Increased flinch resistance and health while Woven Mail is active.

armor.name: Dawn Chorus
armor.description:
Your Daybreak projectiles ignite targets on impact. Your Scorch deals additional damage, and builds to more powerful Ignitions. Dealing damage with Scorch or Ignitions grants melee energy.
Improves Scorch, Ignitions, and Daybreak projectiles.

armor.name: Deimosuffusion
armor.description:
While a Strand Super is equipped, casting Rift will suspend nearby combatants. Suspend deals damage over time, which heals you in the process. Targets who break free from suspension suffer additional damage. Defeating suspended targets heals you a moderate amount.
Improves suspend, causing damage over time. Using your Rift also suspends nearby targets.

armor.name: Doom Fang Pauldron
armor.description:
Defeating targets with Void damage has a chance to grant an escalating bonus to damage with Void weapons. Defeating targets with Void melee grants Super energy.

While Sentinel Shield is active, defeating targets with melee attacks recharges Shield Throw, which extends your Super on hitting a target.
Defeating targets with Void damage grants a bonus to Void weapons, and defeating targets with Void melee grants Super energy. Improves Sentinel Shield.

armor.name: Dunemarchers
armor.description:
Increases sprint speed. Sprinting builds up a static charge. After melee-attacking a combatant, that charge will chain damage to nearby foes. Gain Bolt Charge per target hit by the chain.
Faster sprinting and chain melee damage.

armor.name: Eternal Warrior
armor.description:
[Arc]Arc final blows grant an escalating damage bonus with Arc weapons. While using Fist of Havoc, activating your Super grants an overshield; final blows extend its duration. When it ends, gain a damage bonus to your Arc weapons.
Improved Fist of Havoc. Arc final blows grant a weapon damage bonus.

armor.name: Eunoia
armor.description:
Hellion projectiles deal increased damage the further they travel eventually fracturing into scorching shrapnel.
Improves Hellion.

armor.name: Eye of Another World
armor.description:
Highlights priority targets and improves the regeneration speed of your grenade, melee, and Rift abilities. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
Marks priority targets and buffs ability regen.

armor.name: Fallen Sunstar
armor.description:
Ionic traces you create move faster and grant you additional ability energy. Nearby allies also gain ability energy when you collect an ionic trace.
Improved ionic traces

armor.name: Felwinter's Helm
armor.description:
Powered melee hits weaken targets. Powered melee final blows create a burst of energy that dramatically weakens nearby targets. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the radius of the burst and the length of the weakening effect.
Powered melee kills create a burst of energy that weakens nearby enemies.

armor.name: Foetracer
armor.description:
Damaging a powerful combatant or Guardian with an ability temporarily increases weapon damage of the same type. Defeating that marked target with damage that matches the element creates an Elemental pickup.
Improves weapon damage after damaging a target with an ability.

armor.name: Fortune's Favor
armor.description:
After landing a final blow while at full health, or when out of combat for an extended duration, your shields will slowly recharge into an overshield. 

When you have an overshield, your weapons gain increased accuracy, stability, handling, and damage against combatants, and final blows will grant a short period of increased mobility once the overshield is depleted.
Allows shields to slowly recharge into an overshield.

armor.name: Fr0st-EE5
armor.description:
Increases grenade, melee, and dodge regeneration while sprinting.

Gain stacks of Frost Armor while sprinting. When you have Frost Armor, Stasis weapons deal additional damage.
Sprinting gives energy.

armor.name: Gemini Jester
armor.description:
Dodging disorients nearby enemies and temporarily removes their radar.
Dodging disorients and removes enemy radars.

armor.name: Geomag Stabilizers
armor.description:
Damaging targets with Chaos Reach extends its duration. Collecting Ionic Traces grants you energy for Chaos Reach. Sprinting while near max Bolt Charge will grant stacks over time.
Extended and more frequent Chaos Reach .

armor.name: Getaway Artist
armor.description:
[Grenade]  : Convert your Arc grenade into a Arc Soul and become amplified. The Arc Soul functions as an autonomous turret.
Consuming your Arc grenade grants an Arc Soul and amplifies you.

armor.name: Gifted Conviction
armor.description:
Activating Ascension or Tempest Strike throws bouncing explosives at nearby targets that jolt and damage them. Jolting nearby targets grants you damage resistance.
Improves Ascension and Tempest Strike.

armor.name: Graviton Forfeit
armor.description:
Increases the duration of any invisibility effects. When you gain invisibility, your grenade, melee and class abilities recharge faster. At maximum stacks, you gain a Void Overshield as well.
Improved invisibility.

armor.name: Gwisin Vest
armor.description:
Each Spectral Blades hit or final blow you make before becoming invisible will restore more of your Super energy.

Exiting invisibility while near a target creates a cloud of weakening smoke around you.
Vanish after Spectral Blades kills for more Super energy.

armor.name: Gyrfalcon's Hauberk
armor.description:
Your Void weapons gain Volatile Rounds after you emerge from being invisible. When you are invisible and defeat a combatant while using a finisher, all of your weapons gain bonus damage; you and your nearby allies gain a reserve overshield and improved class ability regeneration. These reserve overshields can be deployed by using a class ability.
After being invisible, your Void weapons gain Volatile Rounds. Finishers while invisible grant bonus damage for all weapons and a reserve overshield for allies.

armor.name: Hallowfire Heart
armor.description:
While your Solar Super is charged, ability final blows cure you and give stacks of Sunfire Furnace.

While Sunfire Furnace is active, grenade and Shieldburst final blows trigger an ignition. Each stack increases grenade regeneration, class ability regeneration, and Super damage. Upon exiting your Super, all stacks are converted into Super energy.
Enhanced abilities with a charged Solar Super.

armor.name: Hazardous Propulsion
armor.description:
Weapon precision hits or final blows have a chance to load a Kinetic Exodus micro-missile. Activating your class ability fires loaded Exodus micro-missiles. Damaging targets with Exodus micro-missiles temporarily increases the damage you deal with other micro-missiles and Rocket Launchers.
Precision weapon hits load micro-missiles. Activating a class ability fires them.

armor.name: Heart of Inmost Light
armor.description:
Using an ability (grenade, melee, or Barricade) empowers the other two abilities. Empowered means abilities have faster regen, melees and grenades do more damage, and Barricades have more hit points.
Use one ability to briefly improve your other abilities.

armor.name: Helm of Saint-14
armor.description:
Weapons of Light persists after exiting Ward of Dawn. While Weapons of Light is active, final blows or sustained damage grant stacks of The Saint; Void and Kinetic damage sources also trigger a suppressing burst.
 
Picking up Ward of Dawn consumes all stacks of The Saint and extends its duration based on how many stacks were consumed.
Weapons of Light is improved; capable of extending Ward of Dawn's duration.

armor.name: Hoarfrost-Z
armor.description:
While you have a Stasis Super equipped, your Barricade becomes a wall of Stasis crystals that slows nearby targets when created. Standing behind this barricade will grant you and your allies increased weapon reload speed, stability, and range.
Replaces Barricade with a wall of Stasis crystals.

armor.name: Icefall Mantle
armor.description:
While you have a Stasis Super equipped, rapid Stasis final blows grant Frost Armor. You heal a small amount whenever you gain Frost Armor. Replaces your class ability with a burst of Stasis energy that freezes nearby combatants, slows nearby opponents, and grants you increased Frost Armor.
Stasis final blows and your class ability grant Frost Armor.

armor.name: Karnstein Armlets
armor.description:
Melee and finisher final blows instantly grant cure and provide restoration for a short duration.
Melee kills restore health for a short duration.

armor.name: Khepri's Horn
armor.description:
Solar final blows recharge your Barricade. While you have a Solar Super equipped, casting your Barricade unleashes waves of Solar energy that damage and scorch targets. Combatants damaged and Guardians defeated by these waves are enveloped in a Sunspot.
Solar kills recharge a Solar blast Barricade.

armor.name: Khepri's Sting
armor.description:
Defeating a weakened target releases a burst of weakening smoke and refunds Void melee ability energy.
Spread weakening effects with smoke.

armor.name: Knucklehead Radar
armor.description:
Provides radar while you're aiming. Enhances your radar resolution while crouched. Visually marks targets. Deals more damage to low-health marked targets. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
Provides radar while you're aiming and marks targets, increasing damage to low-health marked targets.

armor.name: Liar's Handshake
armor.description:
Using your Arc melee ability or being hit by a melee attack will allow you to follow up with an extremely powerful melee counterpunch that will heal you.
Cross Counter regenerates health and deals extra damage.

armor.name: Lion Rampant
armor.description:
Increases hip-fire range and accuracy for Primary ammo weapons. Grants additional aerial maneuverability and enables airborne firing during Lift. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
Buffs maneuverability, hip firing, and firing in Lift.

armor.name: Loreley Splendor Helm
armor.description:
While you have a Solar Super equipped, casting your Barricade or becoming critically wounded with full class ability energy creates a Sunspot at your location.
Create a Sunspot when critically wounded or on Barricade cast.

armor.name: Lucky Pants
armor.description:
Improves sprint, slide, and airborne effectiveness while a Hand Cannon is equipped. For a short time after being drawn, Hand Cannons ready faster, are more accurate, and each hit against a combatant increases Hand Cannon damage.
Hand Cannons ready faster and gain increased accuracy and bonus damage.

armor.name: Lucky Raspberry
armor.description:
Arcbolt Grenades have increased chaining capabilities and jolt targets hit. Damaging combatants with jolt or applying jolt to targets grants additional Arcbolt Grenade energy.
Improves Arcbolt Grenades.

armor.name: Lunafaction Boots
armor.description:
Increases hip-fire range and accuracy for Primary ammo weapons. Your Rifts gain the additional ability to increase weapon reload speeds. Empowering Rift makes weapons effective at longer ranges.
Rifts increase weapon reload speed. Empowering Rift increases range.

armor.name: Mantle of Battle Harmony
armor.description:
Final blows or sustained damage with weapons matching your equipped Super damage type grant you Super energy. When your Super energy is full, you instead gain a temporary bonus to weapon damage of that type. When you've exhausted your Super, matching elemental weapons' damage temporarily causes explosions around the target.
Gain Super energy on elemental weapon takedowns.

armor.name: Mask of Bakris
armor.description:
While you have a Stasis or Arc Super equipped, your Dodge becomes a longer range, faster moving shift that partially cloaks you during use. After shifting, your Stasis and Arc weapons gain a stacking damage bonus for a short time. Final blows with this bonus active refund class ability energy.
Shift instead of dodge.

armor.name: Mask of Fealty
armor.description:
Withering Blade hits and bounces create a small Stasis crystal and refund a portion of melee energy. Using Withering Blade to shatter crystals or frozen targets releases a spread of Withering Blades.
Withering Blade creates Stasis crystals.

armor.name: Mask of the Quiet One
armor.description:
Grants ability energy when you are damaged. While you have a Void super equipped, rapid final blows and final blows while critically wounded grant Devour.
Gain ability energy when you are damaged. While you have a Void Super equipped, final blows grant Devour.

armor.name: Mataiodoxía
armor.description:
Targets damaged by Arcane Needle emit a suspending detonation when defeated. Landing multiple Arcane Needles or Needlestorm on the same target immediately triggers a larger, more powerful detonation. Defeating suspended targets grants melee energy. Your Arcane Needles are strong against [Shield-Piercing]Barrier Champions.
Arcane Needle causes suspending detonations.

armor.name: Mechaneer's Tricksleeves
armor.description:
Increases Sidearm airborne effectiveness, ready speed, and reload speed. While you're critically wounded, swapping to a Sidearm reloads it and increases its damage. While this effect is active, Sidearm final blows reload the weapon and extend the effect's duration.
Boosts Sidearms, especially when you're wounded.

armor.name: Melas Panoplia
armor.description:
Collecting a Firesprite or rapid Solar final blows make you a Forge Master, allowing you to recall your Throwing Hammer. After impacting a target, recall your hammer at full intensity to perform a Perfect Recall, causing an explosion of forge slag. Perfect Recalls and collecting Firesprites extend your time as a Forge Master.
Summon your Throwing Hammer back to you.

armor.name: Mk. 44 Stand Asides
armor.description:
While your Juggernaut shield is active, you slowly gain Bolt Charge stacks over time and increased weapon ready speed. Sprinting while amplified creates an energizing field behind you that grants close by allies speed boost.
Improves Juggernaut. Allies who follow closely gain speed boost.

armor.name: Moirai
armor.description:
Threaded Spike can bounce to Tangles, detonating them and returning immediately. Tangles detonated by Threaded Spike are rewoven and retrieved by it. Catches without a Tangle refund extra melee energy.
Threaded Spike detonates Tangles and pulls them toward you.

armor.name: Mothkeeper's Wraps
armor.description:
Defeat targets to charge up cages of loyal moths that fly toward nearby targets or allies.
 
[Grenade]  : Throw the cage of loyal moths, which are released on impact. Upon reaching targets, moths detonate in a blinding explosion; upon reaching allies, moths provide a Void overshield.
Loyal moths damage targets and aid your allies.

armor.name: Necrotic Grip
armor.description:
Damaging a target with a melee inflicts potent corruption that deals increasing damage over time. Defeating targets afflicted by corruption spreads the condition.

Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all Weapons of Sorrow.
Melee hits inflict potent corruption that deals increasing damage over time.

armor.name: Nezarec's Sin
armor.description:
Void final blows increase ability energy recharge rate. Combatants affected by Soul Siphon are suppressed. Defeating suppressed targets grants more time to Abyssal Extractors.
Void kills increase ability regen.

armor.name: No Backup Plans
armor.description:
Shotgun and melee final blows start your health regeneration. While you have a defensive buff (Void Overshield, Amplified, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail), your Shotguns and melees deal additional damage and final blows with either extend the duration of those buffs. Provides a moderate benefit to Shotgun airborne effectiveness and reload speed.
Shotgun and melee final blows start health regeneration and extend defensive buffs.

armor.name: Nothing Manacles
armor.description:
You gain an additional Scatter Grenade charge. Enables tracking for Scatter Grenade projectiles. Scatter Grenade final blows create additional Scatter Grenade projectiles.
Enhanced Scatter Grenades.

armor.name: Oathkeeper
armor.description:
Bow perfect draw can be held indefinitely. Gain a bonus to the Bow's damage when released, based on how long perfect draw was held. Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of Bows.
Bow perfect draw can be held indefinitely for increased damage.

armor.name: Omnioculus
armor.description:
You gain a second Smoke Bomb charge and have damage resistance while invisible. When you make an ally invisible, they gain damage resistance while invisible and you gain melee energy.
Guardians you make invisible gain damage resistance.

armor.name: One-Eyed Mask
armor.description:
Highlights the target who dares to damage you. Track down and destroy them for an overshield.
Highlight and defeat those that harm you for an overshield.

armor.name: Ophidia Spathe
armor.description:
Gain a second knife per charge. Getting a final blow with a throwing knife grants consecutive knives a temporary stacking damage bonus. Gambler's Dodge refreshes the bonus timer.
Grants two knives per charge.

armor.name: Ophidian Aspect
armor.description:
Improves melee range as well as ready speed and reload for weapons. Provides a small benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.
Improved weapon ready speed, reload, and melee range.

armor.name: Orpheus Rig
armor.description:
Provides ability energy for each target tethered by Deadfall anchors. Moebius Quiver has an additional shot.
Grants Deadfall and Moebius Quiver energy.

armor.name: Osmiomancy Gloves
armor.description:
Your Coldsnap grenades have an additional charge that recharges quicker on hits. The seeker spawned from Coldsnap grenades travels farther.
Your Coldsnap grenades have an additional charge and recharge faster on hits. Seekers travel farther.

armor.name: Peacekeepers
armor.description:
While wielding a Submachine Gun, handling, airborne effectiveness, and movement are all improved, and damage against combatants will increase the longer you remain on target. Submachine Guns are reloaded when stowed.
Reloads stowed SMGs and allows instant ready.

armor.name: Peregrine Greaves
armor.description:
All shoulder charge abilities (Seismic Strike, Hammer Strike, or Shield Bash) deal bonus damage when activated in the air. Damaging mini-bosses, Tormentors, or Champions with your shoulder charge refunds your melee. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
Bonus damage on airborne shoulder charge

armor.name: Phoenix Cradle
armor.description:
Sol Invictus lasts twice as long. Allies who pass through your Sunspot are granted Sol Invictus and Restoration. Dealing sustained [Solar]Solar damage in a Sunspot extends the duration of the Sunspot. Applying Solar buffs to allies has a chance to create a Sunspot at your feet.
Improves Sol Invictus and Sunspots.

armor.name: Phoenix Protocol
armor.description:
Kills and assists you make while standing in your Well of Radiance return Super energy.
Gain Super energy for kills and assists inside Well of Radiance.

armor.name: Point-Contact Cannon Brace
armor.description:
Defeating targets with your Thunderclap melee restores melee energy. Targets near you when you use your Thunderclap suffer lightning strikes and become jolted; being amplified increases the damage of these lightning strikes.
Gain melee energy and create lightning strikes with Thunderclap.

armor.name: Praxic Vestment
armor.description:
You gain an air move jetpack. Weapon and Arc powered melee final blows build up Jetpack Fuel.

While airborne, [Air Dodge] : Charge your jetpack.

On release, activate your jetpack with a forceful blast of exhausting Arc energy then fly forward a short distance based on the amount charged. Collide with a combatant to unleash a blinding blast of energy and gain a temporary bonus to your melee stat.
Gain a tactical air move.

armor.name: Precious Scars
armor.description:
Final blows from weapons with a damage type matching your Super create a burst of healing around you that grants allies restoration. After reviving or being revived, you gain an aura that provides overshields to you and nearby allies.
Revives grant overshields.

armor.name: Promethium Spur
armor.description:
While a Solar Super is equipped, weapon final blows grant class ability energy. Defeating targets with your weapon while standing in a healing rift creates a pulse that grants Radiant to you and nearby allies; an empowering rift instead grants Cure to you and nearby allies. Daybreak final blows grant both effects.
Create combination Healing/Empowering Rifts.

armor.name: Pyrogale Gauntlets
armor.description:
Modifies Burning Maul into a single, high-damage slam of your hammer that creates several cyclones of flame. Consecration's second slam creates a cyclone of flame.
Burning Maul and Consecration create flame cyclones.

armor.name: Radiant Dance Machines
armor.description:
Moderately increases airborne effectiveness and hip fire mobility, range, and accuracy for weapons that use Primary ammo.

Final blows with Primary ammo weapons return dodge energy, which can overflow to create additional charges when full.
Improved Primary weapon performance; final blows refund dodges.

armor.name: Raiden Flux
armor.description:
Quick successive attacks with Arc Staff increase its damage output, duration and jolt targets hit.
Chained Arc Staff hits buff damage and duration.

armor.name: Raiju's Harness
armor.description:
Activating Gathering Storm calls down lightning on all nearby targets, jolting them while also amplifying allies. Defeating Arc debuffed targets grants a small amount of Gathering Storm energy.
Activating Gathering Storm calls down lightning.

armor.name: Rain of Fire
armor.description:
Air dodge reloads all of your weapons and improves the airborne effectiveness of Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles; final blows with these weapons make you radiant. Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles.
Air dodge reloads weapons. Fusion Rifle and Linear Fusion Rifle final blows make you radiant.

armor.name: Relativism
armor.description:
Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Using your class ability temporarily increases this benefit and reloads your equipped weapon from reserves.
Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Class ability increases this benefit.
Gain Woven Mail when you use your grenade.
Grenades grant Woven Mail.

armor.name: Renewal Grasps
armor.description:
Your Duskfield grenades have a much larger effect radius. Allies inside the Duskfield gain Frost Armor and targets inside the area deal reduced damage.
Duskfield grenades have a larger effect and reduce the damage that allies take.

armor.name: Rime-coat Raiment
armor.description:
Your Bleak Watcher turrets are enhanced with extended range and are surrounded by Stasis crystals and a storm. While standing in the storm, you are granted icicles over time. Icicles activate when you fire your weapons, applying Slow to targets they hit.
Bleak Watcher turrets are enhanced and grant icicle projectiles to weapons.

armor.name: Sanguine Alchemy
armor.description:
While standing in any rift, damaging a target will mark it. You deal extra damage to marked targets, and gain additional bonus damage with weapons that have a damage type matching your equipped Super. Weapon final blows while standing in any rift pause the rift's countdown, extending its duration.
Weapon kills while in a rift extend the rift's duration.

armor.name: Sealed Ahamkara Grasps
armor.description:
Powered melee and finisher final blows grant Nightmare Fuel, increasing handling and airborne effectiveness. While active, freshly drawn weapons deal additional damage and grant Nightmare Fuel on final blows. Gaining Nightmare Fuel reloads all holstered weapons.
Melee and finisher final blows reload and enhance holstered weapons.

armor.name: Secant Filaments
armor.description:
While using a Void Super, casting an Empowering Rift will grant you Devour. Damage dealt by you and your allies from within your Empowering Rift will [Disruption] disrupt combatants. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants you class ability energy.
Empowering Rift grants Devour. Damage from inside it [Disruption] disrupts combatants.

armor.name: Second Chance
armor.description:
Gain a second charge of your Shield Throw melee. Your Shield Throws now weaken targets, create a Void Breach on final blows, and become shield-piercing, stunning [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions and refunding a Shield Throw charge when you do. Picking up a Void Breach grants you Shield Throw energy.
Improves your Shield Throw melee.

armor.name: Severance Enclosure
armor.description:
Powered melee final blows unleash a damaging explosion. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the radius and damage of the explosion.
Powered melee kills and finishers unleash explosions.

armor.name: Shards of Galanor
armor.description:
Throwing Knife final blows decrease the cooldown of your Super. Hitting a single target with most Blade Barrage knives in a volley causes them to release a violent Solar explosion; releasing scorching Solar shrapnel. Hits and final blows with Blade Barrage will return Super energy after the Super ends.
Get Super energy for Blade Barrage hits and kills.

armor.name: Shinobu's Vow
armor.description:
Gain an additional Skip Grenade charge. Skip Grenade damage grants Bolt Chargeand gaining Bolt Charge grants Skip Grenade energy. When Bolt Charge is ready, you heal nearby allies and enhance your next Skip Grenade.
Improved Skip Grenade.

armor.name: Skull of Dire Ahamkara
armor.description:
After casting a Nova Bomb, briefly gain a free cast of a fast-moving but weaker Nova Bomb: Lance. Your Nova Bomb: Cataclysm is empowered if detonated with another Nova Bomb. 
Nova Bomb final blows and weapon final blows while you have Devour grant Super energy.
Casting Nova Bomb grants a free cast of a Nova Bomb: Lance.

armor.name: Solipsism
armor.description:
Damaging a target with a melee inflicts potent corruption. Defeating targets afflicted by corruption spreads the condition.
Melee hits inflict potent corruption.
Destroying a Tangle spawns Threadlings.
Tangles spawn Threadlings.

armor.name: Speaker's Sight
armor.description:
Healing grenades spawn a Restorative Turret. Healing allies occasionally spawns an Orb of Power.
Healing grenades spawn a Restorative Turret.

armor.name: Speedloader Slacks
armor.description:
Dodging instantly reloads all your weapons and grants increased reload and handling to you and nearby allies. While the buff is active, additional dodges increase the buff strength and refresh the timer, maxing out at 5 stacks. Dealing sustained damage grants class ability energy.
Dodging grants reload and handling for you and nearby allies. Dodge to increase gains, damage to get dodges.

armor.name: St0mp-EE5
armor.description:
Increases slide distance and improves High Jump, Strafe Jump, and Triple Jump. Take less damage from targets when airborne.
Buffs slide and jumping.

armor.name: Star-Eater Scales
armor.description:
You gain additional Super energy from Orbs of Power you pick up. While your Super energy is full, picking up an Orb of Power overcharges your Super, causing you to gain a burst of healing when cast and a bonus to your Super damage. At maximum overcharge, you also gain an overshield.
Pick up Orbs of Power to overcharge your Super.

armor.name: Starfire Protocol
armor.description:
Fusion Grenades have an additional charge and recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy. Defeating targets with Fusion Grenades grant Rift energy.
Extra Fusion Grenade. Grenade kills charge Rift.

armor.name: Stoicism
armor.description:
Powered melee or finisher final blows unleash a damaging explosion.
Powered melee final blows and finishers unleash explosions.
Damaging a target with a powered melee causes all nearby targets to suffer lightning strikes and become jolted.
Powered melee damage causes lightning strikes.

armor.name: Stormdancer's Brace
armor.description:
Stormtrance hits and final blows increase the damage it deals. Refunds Super energy when it ends. While Stormtrance is equipped, ability damage while amplified grants Bolt Charge.
Enhanced Stormtrance and amplified abilities.

armor.name: Stronghold
armor.description:
Maximizes guard stats on equipped Heavy ammo Swords. You take reduced damage while blocking with a Sword. Rapidly damaging targets after blocking shots with a Sword grants Restoration for a duration determined by the number of shots blocked.
Bonuses to guarding with Swords.

armor.name: Sunbracers
armor.description:
Increases the duration of Solar Grenades. Solar melee kills grant unlimited Solar Grenade energy for a brief time.
Solar grenades burn longer. Melee kills restore them.

armor.name: Swarmers
armor.description:
Destroying a Tangle spawns a Threadling. Your Threadlings unravel targets that they damage.
Threadlings spawn from Tangles and unravel targets.

armor.name: Synthoceps
armor.description:
When you're surrounded, gain increased melee and Super damage, as well as improved weapon handling and reload speed.
Being surrounded buffs damage and weapon handling.

armor.name: The Bombardiers
armor.description:
Dodging leaves behind an explosive that detonates after a short delay, damaging targets around it and creating a secondary effect based on your Super's element:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Suppresses targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.
Dodging leaves behind an explosive that detonates after a short delay, damaging targets around it.

armor.name: The Dragon's Shadow
armor.description:
Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Dodging temporarily increases this benefit, reloads your equipped weapon from reserves, grants improved movement speed, and increases your class ability stat.
Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Dodging increases this benefit.

armor.name: The Path of Burning Steps
armor.description:
Increase the damage of Solar weapons and Solar Ignitions based on the amount of Roaring Flames stacks you have. You are harder to suspend, slow, or freeze, and when you break out, you take no damage from doing so, creating a burst of Solar energy around yourself.
Roaring Flames improves weapon and ignition damage. You are harder to suspend, slow, and freeze.

armor.name: The Sixth Coyote
armor.description:
Gain a second dodge charge. Shortly after dodging, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.
Gain a second dodge charge.
Shortly after using your class ability, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.

armor.name: The Stag
armor.description:
Your Rift provides damage reduction to allied Guardians standing in it. Grants Rift energy when you are critically wounded. On your death, creates a healing rift on your corpse.
Rift grants damage reduction. Grants Rift energy when critically wounded; creates healing rift on death.

armor.name: Transversive Steps
armor.description:
Sprint speed increased. After a short time sprinting, your currently equipped weapon is automatically reloaded.
Buffs sprint. Sprinting reloads current weapon.

armor.name: Triton Vice
armor.description:
Increases Glaive reload speed and melee damage when surrounded. Glaive melee final blows overflow a round to the magazine. Glaive projectile final blows detonate in an explosion.
Improves Glaive melee. Glaive projectile final blows cause detonations.

armor.name: Ursa Furiosa
armor.description:
Move faster while guarding with Sentinel Shield or the Unbreakable shield. Damage blocked with Sentinel Shield is converted to Super energy, and damage blocked with Unbreakable is converted to grenade energy.
Improves Sentinel Shield and Unbreakable.

armor.name: Verity's Brow
armor.description:
Weapon final blows with a damage type matching your grenade grant Death Throes, which provide a grenade damage bonus and grant you grenade energy. When you have Death Throes and throw a grenade, nearby allies gain greatly increased grenade regeneration for a short time.
Weapon final blows boost grenade damage.

armor.name: Vesper of Radius
armor.description:
Rifts periodically release Arc shockwaves. Final blows with these shockwaves create an Arc explosion. While an Arc Super is equipped, the shockwaves and subsequent explosions blind nearby targets. Rift energy recharges faster when you are surrounded by targets.
Rift periodically releases an Arc shockwave.

armor.name: Wings of Sacred Dawn
armor.description:
While you have a [Solar]Solar Super equipped, aiming weapons while you're midair suspends you there for a short time. While this effect is active, you are more resistant to incoming damage and combatants are less accurate. Weapon hits extend this effect's duration, and [Solar]Solar weapon final blows provide Restoration and reload your other weapons from reserves. Provides a large benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
Aiming in midair holds you in place while you have a Solar super equipped.

armor.name: Winter's Guile
armor.description:
Melee and finisher final blows increase melee damage. With maximum stacks, you gain vastly increased melee regeneration speed for a short time.
Melee and finisher final blows increase melee damage.

armor.name: Wishful Ignorance
armor.description:
Gain an additional Frenzied Blade charge. Frenzied Blade and Flechette Storm briefly increase their damage with each strike. Pulses from your Banner of War return melee energy based on the number of allies healed.
Gain an additional Frenzied Blade charge. Banner of War grants melee energy.

armor.name: Wormgod Caress
armor.description:
Defeating a target with melee or a finisher grants escalating melee damage, which decays over time. Higher levels of Burning Fists grant increased weapon damage.
Melee kills increase melee damage.

armor.name: Wormhusk Crown
armor.description:
Activating your class ability grants Cure. Rapid [Solar]Solar final blows grant stacks of Burning Souls that increase Solar ability damage, increase the potency of Dodge's healing, and spreads the healing to nearby allies.
[Solar]Solar final blows grant Burning Souls. Dodge applies Cure.

armor.name: Young Ahamkara's Spine
armor.description:
Increases Tripmine Grenade duration and blast radius. Ability damage grants Tripmine Grenade energy.
Enhanced Tripmines.

armor.name: Spirit of the Assassin
armor.description: Finishers and powered melee final blows grant invisibility.

armor.name: Spirit of the Star-Eater
armor.description:
While your Super energy is full, picking up an Orb of Power overcharges your Super, granting it bonus damage.
Orbs of Power overcharge your Super.

armor.name: Spirit of the Ophidian
armor.description: Weapons ready very quickly.

armor.name: Spirit of Verity
armor.description:
Weapon final blows with a damage type matching your grenade grant a stacking grenade damage bonus and improved grenade regeneration.
Weapon final blows grant grenade damage.

armor.name: Spirit of Caliban
armor.description: Powered melee final blows trigger an ignition.

armor.name: Spirit of the Coyote
armor.description: Gain an additional class ability charge.

armor.name: Spirit of Galanor
armor.description:
Hits and final blows with your Super will return Super energy after it ends.
Super hits return Super energy.

armor.name: Spirit of the Cyrtarachne
armor.description:
Gain Woven Mail when you use your grenade.
Grenades grant Woven Mail.

armor.name: Spirit of Renewal
armor.description:
Allies inside the Duskfield grenade field gain Frost Armor and targets inside the field deal reduced damage.
Improves Duskfield grenades.

armor.name: Spirit of the Gyrfalcon
armor.description:
Your Void weapons gain volatile rounds after you emerge from being invisible.
Gain volatile rounds after being invisible.

armor.name: Spirit of the Dragon
armor.description:
Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Using your class ability temporarily increases this benefit and reloads your equipped weapon from reserves.
Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Class ability increases this benefit.

armor.name: Spirit of the Liar
armor.description:
Dealing damage with a powered melee or being hit by a melee attack will allow you to follow up with an extremely powerful Arc melee counterpunch.
Counterpunch deals extra damage.

armor.name: Spirit of the Foetracer
armor.description:
Damaging a powerful combatant or Guardian with an ability grants you a temporary damage bonus for weapons matching that ability's element.
Abilities grant bonus weapon damage.

armor.name: Spirit of the Wormhusk
armor.description:
Activating your class ability grants Cure. Rapidly defeating combatants grants Burning Souls that increase the potency of healing when using Dodge and spread the healing to nearby allies.
Dodging heals you.

armor.name: Spirit of Hoarfrost
armor.description:
Your Barricade becomes a wall of Stasis crystals that slows nearby targets when created. Activating Thruster creates Stasis crystals.
Replace Barricade with a wall of Stasis crystals.

armor.name: Spirit of Alpha Lupi
armor.description:
Creates a healing pulse when your class ability is activated. Healing allies provides class ability energy.
Casting your class ability heals you and nearby allies.

armor.name: Spirit of Severance
armor.description:
Powered melee or finisher final blows unleash a damaging explosion.
Powered melee final blows and finishers unleash explosions.

armor.name: Spirit of Contact
armor.description:
Damaging a target with a powered melee causes all nearby targets to suffer lightning strikes and become jolted.
Powered melee damage causes lightning strikes.

armor.name: Spirit of the Abeyant
armor.description:
Improves Drengr's Lash. Drengr's Lash projectiles track targets more aggressively and travel farther.
Improves Drengr's Lash.

armor.name: Spirit of Scars
armor.description:
Final blows with weapons that have a damage type matching your Super's element create a burst of healing around you that grants allies restoration.
Weapon final blows heal allies.

armor.name: Spirit of the Bear
armor.description:
Move faster while guarding with the Unbreakable shield. Damage blocked with Unbreakable is converted to grenade energy.
Improves Unbreakable.

armor.name: Spirit of the Armamentarium
armor.description: Gain an additional grenade charge.

armor.name: Spirit of the Eternal Warrior
armor.description:
Gain bonus damage for weapons matching your Super's element when your Super ends.
Gain bonus weapon damage when your Super ends.

armor.name: Spirit of the Horn
armor.description:
Your class ability unleashes waves of Solar energy that damage and scorch nearby targets. Combatants damaged and Guardians defeated by these waves are enveloped in a Sunspot.
Class abilities unleash a Solar blast.

armor.name: Spirit of Apotheosis
armor.description:
Temporarily gain greatly increased melee and grenade regeneration after your Super ends.
Gain melee and grenade regeneration after your Super ends.

armor.name: Spirit of Harmony
armor.description:
Final blows with weapons that have a damage type matching your Super's element grant you Super energy.
Weapon final blows grant Super energy.

armor.name: Spirit of Osmiomancy
armor.description:
Your grenades recharge quicker on hits. The seeker spawned from Coldsnap grenades travels farther.
Improves grenades.

armor.name: Spirit of Starfire
armor.description:
Grenades recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy.
Empowered weapon damage recharges grenades.

armor.name: Spirit of the Stag
armor.description:
Your Rift provides damage reduction to allies standing in it.
Rifts provides damage reduction.

armor.name: Spirit of the Claw
armor.description: Gain an additional melee charge.

armor.name: Spirit of the Filaments
armor.description:
Casting an Empowering Rift will grant you Devour. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants class ability energy.
Empowering Rifts grant you Devour. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants class ability energy.

armor.name: Spirit of the Swarm
armor.description:
Destroying a Tangle spawns Threadlings.
Tangles spawn Threadlings.

armor.name: Spirit of the Necrotic
armor.description:
Damaging a target with a melee inflicts potent corruption. Defeating targets afflicted by corruption spreads the condition.
Melee hits inflict potent corruption.
